summary_paragraph: Mr. Thompson, a male with a history of primary central nervous system lymphoma and prior systemic lymphoma, was readmitted due to worsening ataxia and dizziness. A repeat MRI showed increased enhancement in the right occipital lobe and left internal capsule, concerning for recurrent CNS lymphoma. He received a high-dose methotrexate infusion at 8 g/m² with urinary alkalinization and leucovorin rescue. He developed transient hypokalemia, managed with IV and oral supplementation, and was started on a short course of dexamethasone for symptom improvement. His condition stabilized, and he was discharged home with plans to continue rituximab and methotrexate therapy, including port placement at the next admission.
problems: Other malignant lymphomas, unspecified site, extranodal and solid organ sites
